integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically. A finite exact-integer enumeration is included only as a consistency check and is not used to infer the theorem.
scientific_limitations: Necessary conditions only; no sufficiency or classification of the admissible odd-part shapes is claimed, and the theorem is restricted to integers with 2-adic valuation one.
title: A 2-adic shape theorem for near-perfect numbers congruent to \(2\pmod 4\)
